name: turntype
description: A typing challenge while Claude works: press 1 in an empty prompt, or run /type.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: flow: endless words for the length of the turn. words: a fixed number of words. time: a fixed active time.

wordCount.title: Words
wordCount.description: The number of words in words mode.

timeSeconds.title: Seconds
timeSeconds.description: The active time in time mode. Pauses do not count.

adaptive.title: Adaptive words
adaptive.description: on: about a third of the words practice your weakest letter pairs. off: random words only.

wordList.title: Word list
wordList.description: The words to type: the name of a file in the mod's word-lists/ folder, without .json (english, code). An unknown name uses english.
